messages:
laura_sales: Quick sync — PineBank POC finished discovery. They want real-time transaction summarization + embeddings-based rerank for fraud alerts. They also asked to add EMEA data residency and audit logs. Can we scope this in the current 4-week pilot?
aj_devrel: Thanks, Laura. Main risks: realtime pipeline + strict latency for rerank. Do they have throughput numbers?
mike_ml: They mentioned ~150 req/s peak, 3–5s SLA for end-to-end. Rerank is on top-K (k=20) embeddings, ~512-d.
laura_sales: Correct. They also want multilingual support (EN/ES/FR) and to increase eval set from 100 -> 1,000 prompts during POC.
sofia_security: FYI PineBank requires SOC2 + data residency in eu-west-1 and KMS BYO. For POC we can offer dedicated capacity but BYO-KMS on Dedicated/private only. Need to flag to sales. :exclamation:
rick_eng: For 150 req/s and 3–5s E2E, we should use Dedicated with reserved GPUs (small pool) and streaming responses disabled for summary path. Caching can help for prefix reuse.
aj_devrel: The rerank path: embed generation + nearest-neighbor. Two options: 1) on-host Milvus/FAISS in their VPC (Private) or 2) use our hosted embeddings + vector-store (data leaves host). They prefer residency so option 1.
laura_sales: So summary: they want Dedicated or Private. They asked for pricing estimate for a 4-week POC with Dedicated reserved capacity + onboarding support. Can we ballpark?
mike_ml: Ballpark: small dedicated pool (2x A10 equivalent) + Private vector store + BYO-KMS setup + 8 hrs onboarding eng time. Rough: $25k-$40k for month, depending on infra and support. I'll send a narrower calc after infra details.
sofia_security: Also, security questionnaire: they expect log retention 1 year, access audit logs, and HSM-based key wrapping. We support KMS integrations but HSM may need extra ops work.
laura_sales: Customer just sent this note: "If we cannot meet EMEA residency and KMS BYO within pilot, we will delay." Need a mitigation plan.
rick_eng: Mitigation: offer an isolated Dedicated in eu-west-1 with customer-managed VPC peering and our Private control plane. For BYO-KMS we can do envelope encryption via their KMS but needs config + 2-day ops window. Can we commit within 10 business days?
mike_ml: Technical blocker: the tokenizers in their legacy pipeline break some prompt templates in ES/FR — embeddings drift on test set. We should run quick tokenization/eval before full POC. Suggest 1 day for tokenization pass and small eval (200 prompts) to measure cross-lingual performance.
aj_devrel: Good call. Also request: they want to expand evals to 1k prompts — that's fine but will add latency to results and cost. Recommend progressive rollout: run 200 prompt smoke first, then ramp to 1k once infra is stable.
laura_sales: I'll propose that to PineBank. Can someone draft a one-page POC scope + success criteria? They want 1) 3–5s E2E 90th percentile, 2) Multilingual summary accuracy >= 85% on eval set, 3) Rerank precision@5 >= 92%, 4) Data residency & BYO-KMS in place.
ickoops_typo: sorry ignore
sofia_security: I'll attach the minimal answers for their security questionnaire and list of docs we need: SOC2, encryption at rest, KMS key policy, contact for incident response.
calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: POC kickoff with PineBank — Tue 09:00 CET (invite sent).
laura_sales: Thanks. Action items: @mike_ml run tokenization + 200-prompt eval (ETA 24h). @rick_eng confirm Dedicated eu-west-1 lead time and BYO-KMS steps (ETA 48h). @sofia_security prepare questionnaire answers (ETA EOD). I'll update customer with progressive evaluation plan and pricing range. :thumbsup:
